calibrationReport.caveat: Calibration is the tuning partition, so these are optimistic by construction. They are recorded because a frozen artifact should carry what was known when it was frozen, not because they are a result.

inputs.note: REQUIRED, not optional. Without waist this model family fails the subgroup bias criterion by a wide margin, and there is no fallback to a model that does not need it because every such model fails. A person who cannot supply a waist measurement is refused, and that refusal is a supported-population rule rather than an error.

limitations: Predicts NHANES whole-body DXA body-fat percentage for US survey participants aged 18-59 from four body measurements. Establishes nothing about DEXA equivalence, clinical validity, children, non-US populations, or any Parent Playbook photo scan.
notSkeletalMuscle: Lean mass here is everything that is not fat, including bone mineral, matching the NHANES DXA definition this was trained against. It is NOT skeletal muscle mass, and no conversion factor turns it into one.
ownership: Trained by Parent Playbook on NHANES public-use data published by the US National Center for Health Statistics, which is in the public domain. The trained model and this artifact are owned by Parent Playbook. NCHS does not endorse this work.
refusalConditions: Any required input missing, including waist.
Any input outside its stated range.
A predicted body-fat percentage outside 1-75, which is refused rather than clamped: a clamped value looks measured and is not.
The artifact has not passed a holdout, for any caller asking for a released estimate.

supportedPopulation.note: Adults 18-59. The upper bound is not a modelling choice: no NHANES cycle after 2004 scanned anyone over 59, so the holdout cannot validate them and the model must not be offered to them. See amendment 2.
